# Hamburg depot

The Hamburg depot opens at 05:30, the earliest opening in the network; its documented closing time is not stated (unverified) [src: doc:docs/depots.md]. It has a cold room holding 25 pallets — fewer than Rotterdam's 40 — and its refrigerated temperature range is not stated (unverified) [src: doc:docs/depots.md].

## Staffing and alarms

- The night shift has a night manager instead of a shift lead [src: doc:docs/staff.md].
- A cold-chain alarm at Hamburg pages the night manager rather than calling a shift lead [src: doc:docs/alarms.md].
- Alarms are logged in the incident book within the hour [src: doc:docs/alarms.md].

## Lanes

Baltic Reefer carries chilled goods from Hamburg to Gdansk on Mondays, and Nordfreight runs chilled between Rotterdam and Hamburg on Tuesdays and Fridays [src: doc:docs/carriers.md]. See [depot network](depot-network.md) and [cold-chain alarm handling](../topics/cold-chain-alarms.md).
"}

# Rotterdam depot

The Rotterdam depot is the network's chilled-goods hub, open from 06:00 to 22:00 [src: doc:docs/depots.md]. It runs three shifts, each with a shift lead and six pickers [src: doc:docs/staff.md].

## Cold room

- Holds 40 pallets at 2 to 8 °C [src: doc:docs/depots.md].
- If the room passes 8 °C for ten minutes, the shift lead moves the pallets to a backup room and calls facilities on extension 4410 [src: doc:docs/alarms.md].
- The backup room exists for that overflow, and cold-room work over 10 minutes needs insulated gloves [src: doc:docs/alarms.md; doc:docs/safety.md].

## Operations

Rotterdam is the origin or destination of the chilled Nordfreight lane to Hamburg, on Tuesdays and Fridays [src: doc:docs/carriers.md]. Returns are inspected at the depot that shipped them, so Rotterdam-shipped returns come back to Rotterdam [src: doc:docs/returns.md]. See [depot network](depot-network.md), [cold-chain alarm handling](../topics/cold-chain-alarms.md) and [staffing and shifts](../topics/staffing-and-shifts.md).
"}

# Gdansk depot

The Gdansk depot opened in 2025 and handles dry goods only [src: doc:docs/depots.md]. It is the newest depot in the network, and no opening hours, cold room or shift pattern is documented for it (unverified) [src: doc:docs/depots.md].

Its one documented inbound lane is Baltic Reefer, which carries chilled goods from Hamburg to Gdansk on Mondays [src: doc:docs/carriers.md]. Since the depot handles dry goods only, the chilled Hamburg lane and the dry-goods profile sit in tension — whether chilled goods are accepted at Gdansk is unresolved in the documents (unverified) [src: doc:docs/depots.md; doc:docs/carriers.md].

See [depot network](depot-network.md).

# Carrier lanes

Three carriers serve the depots, split between chilled and dry freight, and each must present a temperature log at hand-over [src: doc:docs/carriers.md].

- **Nordfreight** — chilled goods between [Rotterdam](../entities/rotterdam-depot.md) and [Hamburg](../entities/hamburg-depot.md), on Tuesdays and Fridays [src: doc:docs/carriers.md].
- **Van Dijk** — dry goods daily; the only carrier documented as running every day [src: doc:docs/carriers.md].
- **Baltic Reefer** — chilled goods from [Hamburg](../entities/hamburg-depot.md) to [Gdansk](../entities/gdansk-depot.md) on Mondays [src: doc:docs/carriers.md].

The chilled lanes only touch depots with cold rooms, Rotterdam and Hamburg, though Baltic Reefer delivers chilled goods to Gdansk, a dry-goods-only depot — whether Gdansk accepts chilled deliveries is unresolved in the documents (unverified) [src: doc:docs/depots.md; doc:docs/carriers.md]. Temperature logs at hand-over tie carrier paperwork to the cold-room limits described in [cold-chain alarm handling](../procedures/cold-chain-alarm-handling.md) [src: doc:docs/carriers.md; doc:docs/depots.md].
", "path": "wiki/topics/carrier-lanes.md"}

# Depot network

Four depots make up the network, each with its own opening time, cold capacity and shift pattern [src: doc:docs/depots.md; doc:docs/staff.md]. Only Rotterdam and Hamburg have cold rooms, so chilled goods move through those two [src: doc:docs/depots.md].

| Depot | Opens | Cold room | Shifts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Rotterdam](rotterdam-depot.md) | 06:00, closes 22:00 | 40 pallets at 2–8 °C | 3 |
| [Antwerp](antwerp-depot.md) | 07:00 | none | 2 |
| [Hamburg](hamburg-depot.md) | 05:30 | 25 pallets | night manager on nights |
| [Gdansk](gdansk-depot.md) | not documented | dry goods only | not documented |

- Rotterdam is the only depot whose closing time is documented (22:00); Antwerp, Hamburg and Gdansk closing times are not stated (unverified) [src: doc:docs/depots.md].
- Gdansk is the newest, opened in 2025 [src: doc:docs/depots.md].
- Chilled lanes connect Rotterdam and Hamburg, and Hamburg and Gdansk; Van Dijk carries dry goods daily across the network [src: doc:docs/carriers.md].
- Fire drills run each quarter at every depot [src: doc:docs/safety.md].

See the quick reference [depot hours and capacity](../references/depot-hours-and-capacity.md), and [staffing and shifts](../topics/staffing-and-shifts.md) for how depots are crewed.
", "path": "wiki/entities/depot-network.md"}
